submission.justification: Crystal-K3 gives the best 662 keV energy resolution of the three candidates at every thickness tested. Simulated FWHM for K3 was 3.32% (2 cm), 3.05% (4 cm), 2.99% (5 cm), 3.18% (6 cm), 3.88% (10 cm). The minimum is near 5 cm. K1 was best at 4.42% (5 cm) and K2 at 8.51% (5 cm). The 2025 summary (2.9% / 4.5% / 8.5% at nominal 5 cm) is consistent with these results. The shielding (20 cm lead + 5 cm OFHC copper with radon purge) is in place, so the spectrometer is set up for low-background operation. The project documents contain no measured intrinsic radioactivity data for any candidate, so the low-background suitability of K3's own internal activity was not verified and should be checked with a radiopurity assay before procurement is finalised.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: K3 at 5 cm: 2.99% FWHM, the lowest of all simulated options (K1 best 4.42%, K2 best 8.51%).
